findings.evidenceJa: 普通に動かせるぐらいにはなった
findings.governingReading: The arm has recovered enough for ordinary movement.
findings.explanation: The English overstates limited functional recovery as moving perfectly well.

findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの腕として理解できたか
findings.governingReading: Rin asks whether Shirou can comprehend it specifically as Archer’s arm.
findings.explanation: The English removes the identity relation and makes the question generic understanding.

findings.highlight: if I let this arm free
findings.evidenceJa: その肌を晒すだけ
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes merely exposing the arm’s skin is enough to make his body collapse.
findings.explanation: The English changes minimal skin exposure into fully freeing the arm.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=カラ o2o=1]世界
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s self is written as “world” and read as “shell,” joining personal boundaries to the collapsing world image.
findings.explanation: The English keeps world alone and removes the shell reading.

findings.highlight: Utter obliteration, where the world is covered beneath something mysterious and ends in silence
findings.evidenceJa: 世界そのものが縮んでいく静かで絶対的な終わり
findings.governingReading: The unknown substance paints over his world/self while the world itself shrinks toward a quiet, absolute end.
findings.explanation: The English omits contraction of the world and adds “utter obliteration.”

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=きせき char=2]魔法
findings.governingReading: Only aid on the level of “magic,” read as “miracle,” could prevent certain death.
findings.explanation: The English retains the reading but removes the written technical category of Magic.

findings.highlight: my mind repeated to itself in terror
findings.evidenceJa: 震える頭で繰り返した
findings.governingReading: With his head physically trembling, Shirou repeats the prohibition to himself.
findings.explanation: The English replaces bodily trembling with an abstract mental emotion.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術刻印を移して
findings.governingReading: Rin refers to transferring some of her Magic Crest for the warding intervention.
findings.explanation: The English again presents the procedure as transplantation of her crest wholesale.

findings.evidenceJa: 少しは手ごたえがある筈
findings.governingReading: After a day, Rin expects Shirou to have at least some felt response or grasp.
findings.explanation: The English turns subjective feedback into proof that the intervention is operational.

findings.highlight: if I can suppress his arm
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの腕を制御できるか
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks whether Rin means controlling Archer’s arm.
findings.explanation: The English changes control to suppression.

findings.highlight: it’ll trouble me if you die
findings.evidenceJa: 勝手に死なれたら困る
findings.governingReading: Rin says he must not go and die on his own now that he stands in Archer’s place.
findings.explanation: The English weakens her possessive prohibition and permission structure to generic inconvenience.

findings.evidenceJa: 投影魔術
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively identifies Archer’s Noble Phantasm with his Projection magecraft.
findings.explanation: The English uses generic magic and weakens the systematic craft category.

findings.evidenceJa: 半信半疑
findings.governingReading: Shirou voices the vague knowledge without conviction, half believing and half doubting it.
findings.explanation: The English produces non-idiomatic phrasing.

findings.evidenceJa: 伝えるのはリンの役目
findings.governingReading: Illya says informing Shirou about the proposal is Rin’s responsibility because Rin wants him to project.
findings.explanation: The English changes the duty to communicate information into asking him a question.

findings.highlight: a Conceptual Weapon that exceeds the Servants
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァント以上の魔術行使
findings.governingReading: Rin says they need an exercise of magecraft surpassing a Servant’s combat contribution.
findings.explanation: The English makes the Conceptual Weapon itself generically exceed plural Servants and loses the magecraft-action comparison.

findings.evidenceJa: 霊体であるサーヴァントを打倒する
findings.governingReading: The required Conceptual Armament must defeat Servants precisely as spiritual entities.
findings.explanation: The English omits the target ontology and defeat function.

findings.evidenceJa: 魂魄としての重み
findings.governingReading: The armament defeats through the weight it possesses as a soul or spiritual essence rather than through physical impact.
findings.explanation: The English changes spiritual weight into conceptual weight.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=アウトブレイカー char=3]魂砕き
findings.governingReading: The term is written “soul-crusher” and read “Outbreaker.”
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the reading and removes its meaning-bearing written layer.

findings.highlight: a special Conceptual Weapon that has been passed down through the Tohsaka family
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に伝わる短剣
findings.governingReading: The specific object is a special short blade handed down in the Tohsaka family.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the weapon to its conceptual class and omits that it is a short blade.

findings.evidenceJa: 跡形もないだろう
findings.governingReading: Rin hypothesizes that Saber’s Noble Phantasm would leave no trace of the shadow.
findings.explanation: The English weakens complete erasure to destruction.

findings.evidenceJa: 急造ですぐ壊れる模造品
findings.governingReading: Rin allows that their imitation may be hastily improvised and break immediately.
findings.explanation: The English retains fragility but omits both improvised construction and immediacy.

findings.evidenceJa: あとは戦い方次第
findings.governingReading: If they can produce a superior sword, what follows will depend on how they fight.
findings.explanation: The English weakens tactical contingency into generic ability to manage a fight.

findings.highlight: the simplest and surest way to win
findings.evidenceJa: 最も単純で確実な勝利への方程式
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls superior armament the simplest and most reliable equation leading to victory.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the proposition but removes the analytical equation metaphor.

findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの知識があるなら
findings.governingReading: Rin says if Archer’s knowledge is available, Shirou need only trace it.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the condition into settled possession.

findings.highlight: I have no confidence in myself
findings.evidenceJa: 実感がなければ自信もまったくない
findings.governingReading: Shirou lacks confidence because he has no experiential sense that Rin’s assurance is true.
findings.explanation: The English preserves low confidence but removes its evidential basis.

findings.evidenceJa: より上位の複製者であるアーチャー
findings.governingReading: Archer is explicitly the higher-order replicator whose magical theory Shirou can follow.
findings.explanation: The English retains theory but omits the hierarchy of replication skill.

findings.highlight: you should get close to it
findings.evidenceJa: 本物に似た能力を持つ複製品を象どれる
findings.governingReading: Rin qualifies that Shirou can shape a replica with capabilities similar to the original.
findings.explanation: The English loses the act of shaping, the replica as object, and capability as the axis of similarity.

findings.evidenceJa: リーディングで解析中
findings.governingReading: Illya is analyzing the blueprint through Reading.
findings.explanation: The English omits the named analytic method.

findings.evidenceJa: 大師父の[ruby text=パス o2o=1]護符
findings.governingReading: The object is the great forefather’s talisman, with “pass” as its reading.
findings.explanation: The English changes the ancestral great master into Rin’s personal master and mistakes both talisman and pass for “path.”

findings.highlight: the projected weapon is certain to have flaws
findings.evidenceJa: どこかに綻びができるイメージ
findings.governingReading: In Shirou’s current condition, the single Projection will inevitably contain a fraying or gap somewhere in its mental image.
findings.explanation: The English relocates the flaw from the projected image or conception to the finished weapon.

findings.evidenceJa: 土蔵に転がっている
findings.governingReading: Rin compares the hollow copies to Shirou’s failures lying around the earthen storehouse.
findings.explanation: The English again changes the earthen storehouse into a shed.

findings.highlight: fix it in place with your image
findings.evidenceJa: イメージを重ねて固定化する
findings.governingReading: Shirou must superimpose his image on the prepared material and stabilize it.
findings.explanation: The English omits superimposition and makes the image merely an instrument for fixing the material.

findings.evidenceJa: 士郎の[ruby text=イメージ char=2]投影
findings.governingReading: The contribution is written as Shirou’s Projection and read as “image.”
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the reading and removes Projection.

findings.evidenceJa: 猛特訓
findings.governingReading: Rin plans intensive, severe training in Projection and retrieval of Archer’s knowledge.
findings.explanation: The English removes the intensity of the training regimen.

findings.highlight: how refreshing it is to talk with a bad student
findings.evidenceJa: 出来の悪い教え子とコミュニケーションする
findings.governingReading: Rin jokes that after building-block work with Illya, she might as well communicate with her poor-performing pupil.
findings.explanation: The English adds that the interaction is refreshing and reduces the teacher-pupil engagement to talking.

findings.evidenceJa: ハラん中に指いれてくる
findings.governingReading: Shirou comically recalls Rin putting a finger into his abdomen.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the finger.

findings.evidenceJa: 客間で休んでいる桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura is resting in a guest room of the Emiya house.
findings.explanation: The English makes the borrowed guest room sound like Sakura’s own room.

findings.evidenceJa: 最後の確認
findings.governingReading: Rin says she has one final point to confirm.
findings.explanation: The English broadens a final confirmation into reconfirming everything.

findings.highlight: his influence will still poison you
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎の体にはアーチャーっていうサーヴァントの毒が混ざる
findings.governingReading: Learning Archer’s magecraft will mix the poison represented by the Servant Archer into Shirou’s body.
findings.explanation: The English replaces bodily admixture of a Servant’s poison with vague influence.

findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーから魔術を倣う
findings.governingReading: Shirou will learn magecraft from Archer under controlled exposure.
findings.explanation: The English changes learning a craft from someone into imitating generic magic.

findings.highlight: it’s promising if you’re the one training me
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が指導してくれるなら頼もしい
findings.governingReading: Shirou finds it reassuring to have Rin personally instruct his magecraft training.
findings.explanation: The English changes trust in Rin as a dependable teacher into a vague promising prospect.

findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの魔術を倣う
findings.governingReading: Rin clarifies that learning Archer’s magecraft requires loosening the arm’s restraint during practice.
findings.explanation: The English calls this using Archer’s magic, collapsing the scene’s distinction between direct use and learning under exposure.

findings.evidenceJa: 浮かれていた思考が凍る
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s previously buoyant, excited train of thought freezes at the disclosed requirement.
findings.explanation: The English removes the emotional fall from excitement to terror.

findings.highlight: made me shake in the corner
findings.evidenceJa: 震え続けた
findings.governingReading: He recalls continuing to tremble after loosening the cloth slightly.
findings.explanation: The English invents a location in the corner.
